title: CivBench: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Tool-Mediated Agents in Civilization VI
abstract: arXiv:2609.02459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present CivBench, an open-source benchmark for evaluating language model agents in long-horizon, tool-mediated environments through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). A single episode spans 300+ turns and produces thousands of tool calls over a large action space, requiring sustained planning, state monitoring, and execution under partial observability. The environment exposes 76 MCP tools and a narration layer that converts visual game state into structured text.   We use CivBench to characterise agent behaviour across four model families in 23 admissible runs. The sample is a pilot, not a model ranking: aggregate outcomes do not reliably discriminate models at this scale. translated_title: CivBench：面向《文明VI》中工具介导智能体的长时程基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CivBench，这是一个开源基准测试，用于通过模型上下文协议评估语言模型智能体在长时程、工具介导环境中的表现。单个回合跨越300多个回合，在大动作空间中产生数千次工具调用，要求智能体在部分可观测性条件下进行持续的规划、状态监控和执行。该环境提供了76个MCP工具，以及一个将视觉游戏状态转换为结构化文本的叙述层。我们使用CivBench在23次有效运行中对四个模型系列的智能体行为进行了表征。该样本属于试点研究，而非模型排名：在此规模下，总体结果无法可靠地区分不同模型。相反，我们引入了两个环境可测量的接口级指标：主动监控率，用于捕捉智能体是否主动查询潜在的战略状态；以及RAG@10，用于捕捉智能体在结构化规划中所陈述的承诺是否反映了……
tldr: CivBench是一个基于《文明VI》游戏和MCP协议的开源长时程基准测试，通过300多回合、数千次工具调用的复杂任务评估语言模型智能体，并创新性地提出主动监控率和RAG@10两个接口级指标来刻画智能体行为。
en_tdlr: CivBench is an open-source long-horizon benchmark built on Civilization VI and the Model Context Protocol, evaluating language model agents over 300+ turns and thousands of tool calls, and introducing two interface-level metrics—Proactive Monitoring Rate (PMR) and RAG@10—to characterize agent behavior.
